audit.why: 7/10 with Camille owning Levels 4-5 and 2+ items matches the kits: Hookshot on a 16s cooldown lets her pick every trade before Frozen Domain matters, and Precision Protocol's true damage means the armour you build (and the armour Subjugate steals) does not fully answer her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 2-3 spike is attributed to a 'W true-damage cone'. Camille's true damage is on Precision Protocol (Q); Tactical Sweep (W) deals no true damage — it slows on the outer half and heals her.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon. Precision Protocol: 'next attack deals bonus damage... recast for significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays' with the true-damage flag. Tactical Sweep: 'blasts in a cone after a delay... Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.'
audit.corrected: Spike now credits Precision Protocol for the true damage and Tactical Sweep for the heal, which is also the anti-heal cue the interaction file flags.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction is inverted. wants.you[2] says 'Save Pillar for after her E hookshot lands, cutting off her wall-dash escape' — Pillar of Ice creates impassable TERRAIN, and Hookshot 'pulls herself to a wall'. Dropping a pillar in open lane hands Camille a grapple anchor she did not have. Two more: breakdown/mid claims 'The hextech arena removes her wall', which is invented — The Hextech Ultimatum anchors the target to an area and says nothing about removing terrain. And Hookshot is called a stun repeatedly; Riot's text is 'knocking up enemy champions upon landing', and knockups ignore tenacity.
audit.why: Riot's Hookshot text: 'Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' Riot's Pillar of Ice text: 'creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain'. Riot's The Hextech Ultimatum text: 'Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area.' Also unstated: Adaptive Defenses gives her a shield against the damage type that hit her, so trading autos into her feeds a physical shield.
audit.corrected: Pillar advice reversed — hold it until Hookshot is spent, never gift her a wall. Removed the invented wall-removal on her R. Hookshot corrected from stun to knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot is named as the thing to track eight times with no duration attached.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12, Precision Protocol 9/8/7/6/5, Tactical Sweep 15/14/13/12/11 and The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90.
audit.corrected: 16s and 9s now stated in the cooldown block, the report and the dos.

edits.after: Pillar closes the kit, but it is a wall and Hookshot needs walls — never drop it in open lane where she can grapple off it.

edits.before: At level 1, mirror the aggression — Q Chomp on her first auto attempt steals a sliver of her AD and heals you off the wave. She has no mobility yet so the symmetry is honest: neither of you has the tools to all-in. At level 2 she gets W or E and suddenly she can control trade length; if she gets E first, respect the hookshot angle and bait it by standing near a wall she would want to dash to. At level 3 she has her full short-trade kit and true-damage proc, which punches through armor — do not let her fire Q twice in one trade. The winning pattern is W down before she commits, Chomp the moment she steps in, and Pillar behind her when she tries to disengage; but if she E-stuns you into her W cone from outside your domain, she wins that exchange cleanly. Play patient and take only the trades where she has already spent E.
edits.after: At level 1, mirror the aggression — Q Chomp on her first auto attempt saps a sliver of her AD and heals you off the wave. She has no mobility yet so the symmetry is honest: neither of you has the tools to all-in. At level 2 she gets W or E and suddenly she can control trade length; if she gets E first, respect the hookshot angle and bait it by standing near a wall she would want to dash to. At level 3 she has her full short-trade kit and the Precision Protocol true damage, which punches through armor — do not let her fire Q twice in one trade. The winning pattern is W down before she commits, Chomp the moment she steps in, and Pillar only once her E is spent — a pillar in open lane is a wall she can grapple. If she knocks you up into Tactical Sweep outside your domain, she wins that exchange cleanly. Take only trades where E is gone.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are Camille's clearest advantage window: her Q true-damage proc scales, her E comes up frequently, and she can reset fights by dashing to a wall before your Frozen Domain sustain erases the damage she dealt. Accept that short trades go her way and look instead for the extended all-in after her E hookshot is on cooldown — with no gap-closer she cannot escape your W zone or Pillar. At level 6 the equation shifts — her R isolates you, which she likely intended as a kill tool, but it also gives Subjugate a clean target: R the moment she casts her ult and drain her armor and MR for the entire duel. The hextech arena removes her wall, so her E dash has nowhere to send her. This window is genuinely even and comes down to whether you landed Pillar before she burned your health down.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are Camille's clearest advantage window: her Precision Protocol true damage scales, her E comes up every 16s, and she can reset fights by dashing to a wall before your Frozen Domain sustain erases what she dealt. Accept that short trades go her way and look instead for the extended all-in after Hookshot is on cooldown — with no gap-closer she cannot escape your W zone or Pillar. At level 6 the equation shifts — her R anchors you into a 1v1 arena, which she intends as a kill tool, but it also parks her at 475 range and gives Subjugate a clean target: R the moment she casts and drain her armor and MR for the entire duel. Her walls do not disappear in there, so keep Pillar unspent. This window is even and comes down to whether you landed Pillar before she burned your health down.

edits.after: Neither champion has their mobility tool yet — Chomp's AD sap and King's Tribute healing match Camille's raw damage output evenly at one point.

edits.after: Hookshot is back every 16s at these levels and lets her dictate the approach angle, knocking you up before your W zone is active and trading on her terms.

notes: Highest-value fix here is the inverted Pillar advice: Hookshot grapples to a wall and Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain, so the old line ('Save Pillar for after her E hookshot lands, cutting off her wall-dash escape') was actively handing Camille an anchor in open lane. Same class of error as the Akshan entry in this slice. Also removed the invented claim that The Hextech Ultimatum 'removes her wall' — Riot's text only anchors the target to the area. Corrected 'W true-damage cone' (true damage is on Precision Protocol; Tactical Sweep heals her) and 'E hookshot stun' (it is a knockup, so tenacity does nothing). One more 'AS steal' instance killed in whys[0]. Adaptive Defenses shielding against the damage type that hit her is real per Riot's text but I could not fit it in band anywhere without cutting something better — flagging it here rather than forcing it.
